acceptance: namespace() normalizes remote URLs (stripping trailing slashes and .git) so equivalent URLs share one store.
A migration path unifies existing cache namespaces without breaking offline reads.
context: Identified in Claim 3 of initial cache review. BenchBox has namespaces e688dcd1868ed3f8 (.git) and 5cf74613c45f4c2a (no .git), duplicating ~235 MB of cache.
description: namespace(ref) hashes ref.remote + '\0' + ref.branch. Remotes referring to the same repository with or without a trailing .git (e.g. https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/BenchBox vs .../BenchBox.git) hash to different namespaces (5cf74613c45f4c2a vs e688dcd1868ed3f8), duplicating cache storage. Normalizing URL spellings (stripping trailing slashes and .git suffix) with an automated migration path would unify them.
